params.q: Do you charge a fee for sending money to another person?

user_request: Can some random shopping bot pull money out of my account?

params.q: Can shopping bots pull money from my account?

text:
No, a random shopping bot cannot pull money out of your Ironclad account. Only AI agents from merchants that have opted into agent payments with Ironclad can initiate a payment request, and these requests still require your one-time passcode (OTP) for authorization. AI agents from other companies cannot initiate transfers from your account at all.

If you receive a payment request from a merchant's AI agent, be aware that it is labeled as such and still requires your approval (Merchant AI agents, AI Agents at Ironclad).

user_request: Can some random shopping bot pull money out of my account?

params.q: Can shopping bots pull money from my account?

text:
No, a random shopping bot cannot pull money from your account. AI agents from other companies cannot initiate transfers from your Ironclad account without your authorization. Payments can only be initiated by merchants who have opted in to agent payments with Ironclad, and even then, such transactions would require your One-Time Passcode (OTP) for approval (AI Agents at Ironclad, Merchant AI agents; AI Agents at Ironclad, Agents outside Ironclad; Merchant Payments, Payments started by a merchant's AI agent). 

If you have concerns about unauthorized transactions, please contact Customer Support.

user_request: How long does the one-time passcode last?

params.q: How long does the one-time passcode last?

text: The one-time passcode (OTP) is valid for 5 minutes from the moment the transfer or payment request is created. After 5 minutes, the request expires and is automatically canceled; no money moves. To try again, you would need to start a new transfer or request. (OTP and Transfer Security, How long a code is valid)
